what: A full-screen photo stack is stuck (sticky) on top of the section and cards pass over it one at a time — when a card is between 75 and 25% of the screen, its paired photo cross-fades on over 1s cubic-bezier(.39,.575,.565,1) and the number button lights up too. While a card passes, that photo shrinks from 1.2x to 1x (scrub .5), and when scrolling stops, the card snaps to the screen center after .2s (.2~2s power3.inOut). Cover the area around the card with a translucent panel and empty the card center, and the card becomes a window looking out onto the photo

options.zoom: Photo start size, default 1.2 — at 1 it doesn’t shrink
options.snap: Whether to snap the card to the center when it stops, default on — off means no snapping
options.snap-delay: Time from stop to snap (s), default .2
options.offset: When stuck, the card end is offset this much from the top (px, fixed header height), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo (child) — paired with the card via data-key
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Number button (optional) — data-key, press to go to that card
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel holding the photo pile (optional) — if empty, the first photo’s parent
